body: Deduction engine shipped and merged to main (merge ff24e713, product commit ce89d042). Unit: 26 new tests + 192-test combined regression green at the merged state; ruff clean; pre-commit gate green. Live before/after on the isolated 8765 harness (zai/glm-4.5-flash): baseline 'Do not use tools. What is my country?' -> 'I cannot determine your country without using tools' (0 tools); after the fix the same turn -> 'Your country is Kenya (KE).' (0 tools, no candidate list). Boot log: 'user context deduced: KE (region; high confidence)' + 'user location persisted to memory (keyed)'; trace DB holds exactly one keyed row (subject:location, freshness=boot). Region-implicit weather turn targeted accuweather.com/en/ke/nairobi/ directly. Verified vs unit-tested vs assumed: deduced-context answers + boot deduce/persist legs live-verified; remaining prompts (trending) provider-limited this run — recorded, not claimed. Scratching the claim-body file; worktree/branch teardown next.
